Main Circuit
How to run it
Straight sets: do all the sets of each exercise, rest, then move to the next.
Overhead squat – single arm
3 x 8-12 each sideAny kitModerate
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Hold a weight locked out overhead in one hand, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, core braced, other arm out for balance.

Movement: Sit the hips down keeping the weight stacked overhead and the arm locked, to a comfortable depth, then drive up to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the weight over the mid-foot with a locked active arm, the chest up, and the knees over the toes. Keep the hips and shoulders level, and reduce depth if the torso tips or the arm drifts.

Deadlift – trap bar, staggered stance
3 x 6-10 each sideTrap barModerate
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Stand in the trap bar with the working foot flat under you and the other foot a half step back, up on its toes as a kickstand. Hinge down, grip the handles in the middle, back flat, core braced.

Movement: Push through the front foot and stand tall, then sit the hips back and lower the bar under control. Complete the set, then swap sides.

Focus: Most of the weight stays on the front heel, the back foot only balances. Keep the hips level and square, not twisting towards the back leg, and the back flat throughout.

Pallof press – standing lunge
3 x 8-12Cable/BandLight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height in a split stance, one foot forward in a shallow lunge, hands at the chest, core braced.

Movement: Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the pull that wants to twist you, hold briefly, then draw it back.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square over the split stance, letting nothing rotate you towards the cable. The lunge stance narrows your base, so the anti-rotation job gets harder. Keep the ribs down and press smoothly.

Dips – machine assisted
3 x 8-12Assisted dip machineBodyweight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Set the assist, grip the dip bars, arms straight, chest up, shoulders down, ribs down.

Movement: Bend the elbows to lower until the upper arms are about parallel, then press back up to straight arms.

Focus: Lower only to a comfortable shoulder depth, not below, to protect the shoulders. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, the chest up, and press up under control.

Hamstring curl – Swiss ball, bilateral
3 x 8-12Swiss ballBodyweight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Lie on your back, heels on a Swiss ball, legs straight, hips lifted so the body is in a straight line, arms flat.

Movement: Curl the ball towards the buttocks by bending the knees, keeping the hips lifted, then roll back out under control.

Focus: Keep the hips lifted and level, not dropping, and the ball steady. Keep the core braced, and control the roll back out.

Wrist flexion – supported
3 x 8-12Any kitLight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Sit with the forearm resting along a thigh or bench, palm facing up, wrist and hand free over the edge, holding a light weight.

Movement: Curl the knuckles up towards the forearm, hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly to where the range stays pain-free rather than letting the weight drop the wrist back.

Focus: Move only at the wrist and only through the range that stays comfortable. The forearm never lifts off its support. Start lighter than feels necessary and add range before adding weight.

Balance – single leg eyes closed
3 x 40s each sideBodyweightBodyweight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Stand on one leg near a support, torso tall, other foot lifted, then close the eyes.

Movement: Hold the single-leg balance with the eyes closed for the set time, then swap.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft, making constant small ankle adjustments without sight. Keep the core engaged, breathe, and keep support within reach.

Push-up plus – floor
3 x 8-12MatBodyweight
Logged weight (if necessary)✓

Start: Set up in a push-up position, hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line, core braced.

Movement: Perform a push-up, and at the top push a little further to spread the shoulder blades (the plus), then relax and repeat.

Focus: Keep the body in a straight line, not sagging or piking. Keep the elbows tucked to about 45 degrees, and on the plus spread the shoulder blades rather than shrugging.

Romanian deadlift

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, holding a weight in front of your thighs, or hands empty, with a soft bend in the knees. Set the shoulders back and brace the core.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front of your legs, keeping it close, until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never let it round. The movement is a hip hinge, not a squat, and the weight stays close to your legs. Only go as low as you can keep the back flat.

Face pull – cable, with rotation

Start: Stand at a cable at head height, a rope in hand, arms extended forward, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Pull towards the face and rotate the hands so the knuckles finish pointing up and back, elbows high, then return under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows high and add the rotation from the shoulders, not shrugging. Keep the ribs down and the torso still, and control the return.

External rotation – cable, standing

Start: Stand side-on to a cable at elbow height, the near elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees, forearm across the body.

Movement: Rotate the forearm outward away from the body, keeping the elbow pinned, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow glued to the side and move only the forearm. Keep the shoulder down and the ribs still, and control the return.

Reverse fly – single arm

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back, a light dumbbell in one hand hanging below the chest, elbow softly bent, other hand supporting.

Movement: Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height, squeezing the shoulder blade, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep a soft elbow bend and lead with the back of the hand, squeezing the shoulder blade. Keep the back flat and don't swing or shrug, using a light weight.

3 x 10 · 4kg
Pullover

Start: Lie on a bench holding a single dumbbell over the chest with both hands, arms fairly straight, ribs down, feet planted.

Movement: Lower the weight back overhead in an arc to a comfortable shoulder stretch, then pull it back over the chest.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back as the arms go overhead. Keep the arms fairly straight, go only to a comfortable stretch, and control the arc.

To burn x2 · 6kg
Wood chop – DB

Start: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in both hands, feet hip-width, knees soft, core braced.

Movement: Sweep the weight down and across from above one shoulder to the opposite hip (or the reverse), rotating through the trunk, then return.

Focus: Turn through the trunk with the hips pivoting and knees soft, not twisting the lower back. Keep the ribs down, control the sweep, and don't fling the weight.

3 x 10 each · Moderate
Balance – single leg knee drive

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, the other knee ready to drive up, arms ready.

Movement: Drive the free knee up towards hip height, hold the balance briefly, then lower under control and repeat.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft, staying tall as the knee drives up. Fix the eyes on a point, control the drive and lower, and keep the core engaged.

3 x 8 each · Light
